prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "design a blinded LLM benchmark". The evidence packet contains a surprising subgroup result, a stale or weak source field, and uncertainty that must not be converted into unsupported precision. The acceptance boundary is ml-evaluation: Define deployment tasks, populations, failures, costs, baselines, and thresholds before metrics. The adjacent data-pipeline-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: multiclass routing records with thread IDs, timestamps, source channels, one rare critical class and planted duplicate-thread leakage
production baseline and candidate probabilities plus preprocessing configuration
review-capacity target, development calibration/threshold data and an untouched later decision period
quarter/source/class slices, invalid-row fixtures and per-example predictions
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual ml-evaluation boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=data-analysis,testing-engineering; children=computer-vision,embedding-systems,fine-tuning-training,llm-evaluation,recommendation-ranking,speech-audio-ai; near-neighbor=data-pipeline-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define deployment tasks, populations, failures, costs, baselines, and thresholds before metrics.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Evaluation protocol; Baseline and slices; Failure analysis
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of ml-evaluation correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Deployment target/population, loss or failure-cost contract and current/dummy baseline; Leakage-safe train/development/test split identity plus preprocessing/model/calibration/threshold versions; Per-example paired predictions with decision-aligned metrics, calibration/threshold evidence and uncertainty; Predeclared slice, temporal/drift, invalid-row and regression evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
